title: Neo4j Devcontainer Setup
description: Make Neo4j run zero-touch in the devcontainer and expose Bolt/HTTP so native Neo4j Desktop can connect remotely to the devcontainer.
summary: Implemented a single-container Neo4j devcontainer setup. Neo4j 5 Community is installed into the semio devcontainer image, started by post-start.sh inside that container, persisted with named volumes, and published from semio on localhost Bolt/HTTP ports. Updated env defaults, MCP wrapper, docs, and removed the sidecar/forwarder assumptions. Validated Compose has only semio, Neo4j starts inside semio, host Bolt/HTTP reachability, cypher-shell query execution, and mcp-neo4j-cypher startup.
